services.name: Parasailing at Sportsman Marina
services.desc: Best Views of Orange Beach! All Ages Welcome! Duration On the boat for about an hour About Our trained and professional staff look forward to providing you with a fun and safe experience! You will take off and land gently right on the back of our boat, so there is no need to get wet. If you want to hop in the water, you are more than welcome to take a dip in the emerald green waters. Please dress comfortably and wear sunscreen. We recommend applying it ahead of time so that you can relax once you are on the boat.
